title: Der Todesking (1990) is the magnum opus of German horror

commenti.body:
This movie was a trip. Not only did i like it, I found it unusually calming. I liked that decomposing body segment between each vignette. I agree with your post, but there was also something about it that resonated with me on a personal level in that weirdly relaxing way. I don't normally think of death as anything beautiful or comforting but I did in this movie. 

The vignettes were also smart and seemed so realistic, like you are really looking into people's homes and lives in a way that's satisfying. Like a very special dream.

Exactly what I felt as well. This concept could have easily led to a collection of random splatter scenes (which I probably would have still liked, but in a less intellectual way), but it's much more.
